COMPUTER STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Data communication, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data communication.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data communication.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Data communication.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data communication.

2. When learning Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards

4. When learning Computer set up, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer set up.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer set up.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer set up.

5. When learning Evolution and Development of Computers, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Evolution and Development of Computers.

6. When learning Input/Output Devices, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Input/Output Devices.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Input/Output Devices.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Input/Output Devices.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Input/Output Devices.

7. When learning Computer Organisation and Architecture, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Organisation and Architecture.

8. When learning Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.

9. When learning Computer storage, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer storage.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer storage.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer storage.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer storage.

10. When learning Operating System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating System.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating System.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Operating System.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating System.

11. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

12. When learning Central Processing Unit, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Central Processing Unit.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Central Processing Unit.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Central Processing Unit.

13. When learning Data Transmission Media, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Transmission Media.

14. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

15. When learning Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.

   C. Skip safety briefings for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.

16. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Central Processing Unit and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Data communication and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
